Small-batch coffee, roasted in Portland

Ridgeline Coffee Roasters has roasted single-origin coffee on the east side of Portland since 2009.

Our roasting process

Every batch is roasted to order in a twelve-kilo drum roaster and rested for four days before shipping.

Visit the roastery

The roastery tasting room is open Monday to Friday, 7am to 4pm, and Saturdays from 8am until noon.

  • Free cupping sessions every Saturday at ten in the morning.
  • Wholesale accounts available for cafes across the Pacific Northwest.

Read more about our sourcing practices or follow us on social media.
